artists.biography: Pop Will Eat Itself (also known as PWEI or The Poppies) are an English alternative rock band, originally formed in Stourbridge in 1986, with members from Birmingham, Coventry and the Black Country. Initially known as a Grebo act, their style changed to incorporate sample driven indie and industrial rock. Their highest charting single was 1993's "Get The Girl! Kill The Baddies!". After initially disbanding in 1996, and having a brief reformation in 2005, they issued their first release in over five years in 2010.

perplexity.description:
Released in 1994 on Infectious Records, Dos Dedos Mis Amigos is the fifth studio album by English industrial rock band Pop Will Eat Itself. Marking a significant shift in the band’s sound, the album embraces a heavier industrial influence compared to their earlier work, featuring more aggressive guitar lines, digital textures, and a reduced reliance on samples. This stylistic evolution reflects the band’s engagement with the industrial rock movement of the mid-1990s, with production choices that align with the era’s sonic trends, including the influence of Trent Reznor’s Nothing Records, which released the album in the United States.

Within Pop Will Eat Itself’s discography, Dos Dedos Mis Amigos stands out as their last studio album before their initial disbandment in 1996. It represents a mature, harder-edged phase for the group, departing from their earlier dance-pop and bubblegum-industrial roots. The album received positive critical attention, with Record Collector calling it “arguably their best,” and it achieved modest commercial success, reaching number 132 on the Australian Albums chart. Its legacy endures as a defining work of the band’s industrial period and a notable release in the UK’s 1990s alternative rock scene.
